audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[] side/rating disagreed with content win[] on every one of 7 rows — full said Zyra L1-3, Skill L4-6/2items; content said Skill L1-3, Zyra L4-6, Sona 2items. Full-layer breakdown fields were generic template prose ('chord the contacts', 'aura economy') with no real ability names.
audit.why: Content's reasoning is grounded in real kit facts (Zyra's plant-boosted poke is finite on mana/seeds early so Sona's sustain refills the chip, her E root plus seeded plants ramp from level 4-6, Stranglethorn chains a burst at 6, and Sona's grouped Crescendo out-values her single plant zone once teamfights start) and matches Zyra's actual pattern; full-layer text was templated filler.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all 7 phases[].side/.rating to match content win[] (already correct on disk, no win[] edit needed), rewrote each why with the grounded reasoning, and rewrote breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/feeding/carry/late, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, and loading using real ability names (Grasping Roots, Deadly Spines, Stranglethorn, Aria of Perseverance, Song of Celerity, Crescendo).

audit.why: Level 6 Stranglethorn chain-CC burst threat, first-item plant-poke peak (Liandry's), and two-item Sona teamfight swing are now correctly reflected in the rewritten phases and breakdown.carry/late.
